# Netpin

Netpin is a DevOps intelligence platform that helps teams measure and reduce Infrastructure Debt (IDI), optimize cloud costs, and improve system reliability in real-time. It provides deep visibility into Kubernetes and cloud resources.

## Core Information
- Website: [https://netpin.io](https://netpin.io)
- Contact: contact@netpin.io
- Documentation: [https://docs.netpin.io](https://docs.netpin.io)
- Application: [https://dash.netpin.io](https://dash.netpin.io)

## Key Features
- **Infrastructure Debt Index (IDI)**: A proprietary score quantifying your technical debt in infrastructure.
- **Cost Optimization**: Real-time insights to identify and eliminate wasted cloud spend.
- **Topology Visualization**: Interactive mapping of Kubernetes clusters and dependencies.
- **Deployment Gating**: Policy-driven gates to prevent misconfigured deployments.
